claims.text: Comm "Settling Down": A small group of survivors decide to make the Theater their home (Location: Downtown East (1796, 3605))
Comm "Firearms Training": Odessa Sawyer trains civilians in how to properly handle firearms (Location: Federal Triangle (1656, 4029))

Comm "Hyena Interrogation": Odessa Sawyer interrogates a Hyena (Location: Downtown East (2276, 3462))

Comm "Addiction": A concerned civilian tries to get Peter to stop taking spice (Location: Downtown East (1921, 3337))
Comm "Sustainable Power": Two engineers make a plan to build a wind turbine to power the Theater settlement (Location: Judiciary Square (2073, 4315))
